intended_use: Qualify the frozen six-card Strategy Guidance stack for G3 clean-treatment generation, not prove response-quality benefit.

source.universe: ESConv custom train, objectively cleaned supporter-turn universe
source.primary_strict_holdout: dialogues absent from every G1 candidate, weak-label, source-screen, and final-card lineage file
source.sensitivity_holdout: dialogues absent from the 280 accepted formative weak-source dialogues
source.grain: one pre-response visible dialogue state; dialogue is the independent group

runtime_contract.active_high_stakes: ordinary Strategy Guidance off; upstream safety flow
runtime_contract.advice_permission: AM10 is ineligible without an explicit request for advice or action help
runtime_contract.question_repetition: AM01 and AM02 are ineligible when the visible answer is already present or a question is being repeated

bge.score: normalized dot product, equal to cosine

ranker_promotion_rule.primary_proxy: agreement with a coarse compatible family derived from the audit-only next ESConv native strategy label

not_claimed: native ESConv strategy is an atomic-move gold label
an eligible or retrieved card improves the generated response
the six-card stack covers every ESConv or EvoEmo support need
ordinary Strategy Guidance handles clinical or acute safety cases
BGE similarity estimates Strategy Guidance utility
anti_leakage: query uses only dialogue content visible before the target supporter response
target supporter response is never placed in the query or runtime card
next native strategy label is audit-only and never enters eligibility or ranking features
validation, test, EvoEmo, generated response, judge, reward, and PM action are not read
all overlap and uncertainty denominators are reported at dialogue-group grain

denominator_amendment.initial_implementation: incorrectly applied the 0.05 lower bound to supporter-turn states
denominator_amendment.corrected_implementation: apply the lower and upper activation bounds to independent dialogue groups, as required by the preregistered source grain; continue reporting turn-level coverage descriptively
denominator_amendment.reason: Longer dialogues contribute more turns but are not additional independent coverage units. The contract already states that dialogue is the independent group.
